results.overview: Weighed down by memories she can't shake, high schooler Koyuki Hikawa keeps everyone at arm's length — until three schoolmates draw her out of her shell.
results.name: The Ramparts of Ice

results.overview: Reincarnated as a sentient weapon with memories of his past life, but not his name, a magical sword saves a young beastgirl from a life of slavery. Fran, the cat-eared girl, becomes his wielder, and wants only to grow stronger, while the sword wants to know why he is here. Together, the strange duo's journey has only just begun!
results.name: Reincarnated as a Sword

results.original_name: 新テニスの王子様 U-17 WORLD CUP
results.overview: The story follows the unfolding of the U-17 World Cup, which takes place at the KCC Arena, in Melbourne, Australia. A total of 32 countries are participating in this long-awaited competition, and only 16 of them will manage to qualify for the final stages…
results.name: The Prince of Tennis II U-17 WORLD CUP

results.original_name: 帰還者の魔法は特別です
results.overview: In a land dominated by the formidable Shadow Worlds, most of humanity has been destroyed. To rescue their planet from impending doom, six brave heroes fight a perilous battle…and fail. But there’s a glimpse of hope when Desir, one of the last mages, is suddenly sent back in time 13 years! Now armed with knowledge of the grim future, can he alter the course of history and save the world?
results.name: A Returner's Magic Should Be Special

results.overview: Buy! Sell! Profit...or lose it all! University student Kurumi Fukuga jumps into the fast-moving world of foreign exchange trading to recover the 20 million yen her late mother lost. Together with fellow FX enthusiasts Mochiko, Mebuki, and Yasuko, she’ll battle volatile markets where every decision can lead to fortune—or disaster!
results.name: FX Fighter Kurumi-chan

results.original_name: 獣王武神ダンデヴァイン
results.overview: Twenty years have passed since the combining robot Dandivine repelled the mysterious enemy known as the Aposdoll. The world was at peace, but the toy manufacturer Kasuga, which once took the world by storm through its Dandivine toy line, was in a steady decline due to an over-reliance on the franchise. Genjuro Shijima, the president of Kasga, now yearns for the resurrection of Dandivine, even if it means disturbing the peace of the world. As if his desire reached the heavens, an Aposdoll appears in Tokyo once again.
results.name: Dandivine

results.overview: Get all Cure and Relaxed with PetitCure, Precure's first series featuring "Little Friends."
results.name: PetitCure ~Precure Fairies~

results.overview: Anime based on the mascot characters of the Mazimeni Yabacity YouTube commentary group.
